source_scope: FAO ECOCROP species-level optimal soil pH intervals; no temperature or annual-rainfall rule is mapped into the active pre-sowing regression feature contract

rules.source_locator: FAO ECOCROP code 1232, Ecology table, Soil PH row, Optimal Min/Max
rules.transformation: identity; compare source optimal interval directly with dataset soil_pH
rules.variety_or_stage: species-level; no cultivar or growth-stage resolution
rules.water_regime: not specified by the pH descriptor; drainage is a separate source field
rules.approval_rationale: Candidate only: exact FAO ECOCROP optimal pH interval and dataset unit match; geographic and cultivar applicability require independent review.
